content.title: Weighted Bergman projection in radial trees
content.abstract: We study the Bergman projection $P_ω$ on a radial tree with respect to weighted harmonic Bergman spaces $A^p_ω$, where $ω$ is a positive radial weight. We prove that for all such weights and $1<p<\infty $, the Bergman projection $P_ω$ is bounded from $L^p(ω) $ to $A^p_ω$ and $L^\infty \to \mathcal{B} $, where $\mathcal{B} $ is the Bloch space of the tree. We also provide a characterization of the weights $ω$ for which the positive Bergman projection $P_ω^+ $ is bounded from $L^p(ω) $ to $L^p(ω) $.
